description: Career events the tracker screens, worldwide: in-house days, insight days, spring weeks, academies, career fairs, competitions and hackathons, hosted by firms, student societies and others, each verified on the host's own page. Student events by default; `professional: include` adds the industry conferences and meetups that take students, `only` shows just those. `track: quant` is the hackathons, competitions and quant / tech / AI events. Open events only (the apply-by date has not passed and the event has not taken place) unless `include_past`, which adds closed ones flagged `closed`; sorted by the next date that matters; `days` keeps events starting or closing within N days.

city.description: City name as the event lists it, e.g. Amsterdam

days.description: Only events starting or closing within N days

include_past.description: Also list events that already took place

query.description: Words to match in host or title

type.description: Kind of event, one of: inhouse_day, insight_day, spring_week, career_fair, conference, competition, networking, webinar, academy

name: list_events
title: Career events
